relationship.statement: A simple pendulum's period depends on its length and gravity, not its mass. Longer strings swing slower, stronger gravity swings faster, and for small angles the release angle sets the swing width without changing the period.
assumptions: The string is massless and does not stretch.
Air resistance and pivot friction are neglected.
Valid for small release angles (under 20 degrees).

quantities.label: Length
quantities.meaning: Distance from the pivot to the center of the bob.

quantities.label: Gravity
quantities.meaning: Gravitational acceleration pulling the bob downward.

quantities.label: Bob mass
quantities.meaning: Mass of the pendulum bob; affects energy but not period.

quantities.label: Release angle
quantities.meaning: Starting angle from vertical; sets the swing amplitude.

quantities.label: Period
quantities.meaning: Time required for one complete back-and-forth swing.

quantities.label: Frequency
quantities.meaning: Number of complete swings per second.

quantities.label: Max speed
quantities.meaning: Peak speed of the bob at the bottom of the swing.

quantities.label: Current angle
quantities.meaning: Instantaneous angle of the pendulum from vertical.

math.code: function compute(inputs, t) { var L = 1.6; var g = 9.81; var angle0 = 18; var theta0 = angle0 * Math.PI / 180; var mass = inputs.mass; var omega = Math.sqrt(g / L); var period = 2 * Math.PI / omega; var frequency = 1 / period; var theta = theta0 * Math.cos(omega * t); var angle = angle0 * Math.cos(omega * t); var max_speed = Math.sqrt(2 * g * L * (1 - Math.cos(theta0))); var bob_x = L * Math.sin(theta); var bob_y = -L * Math.cos(theta); var bob_size = 0.25 + ((mass - 0.5) / 4.5) * 0.6; var arrow_y = bob_y - (0.15 + 0.08 * mass); var energy = mass * g * L * (1 - Math.cos(theta0)); var is_light = mass < 1.5; var is_heavy = mass > 3.5; return { period: period, frequency: frequency, max_speed: max_speed, angle: angle, bob_x: bob_x, bob_y: bob_y, bob_size: bob_size, arrow_y: arrow_y, energy: energy, is_light: is_light, is_heavy: is_heavy }; }

always: Period stays 2.54 s at any mass

lesson.title: What Changes a Pendulum Swing?
lesson.description: Watch a pendulum swing while a graph tracks its angle over time. Adjust the bob mass slider to see how weight changes without affecting the swing period.
lesson.instructions: Use the Bob mass slider to make the pendulum heavier or lighter, and watch the bob size, the weight arrow, and the angle-time graph as it swings.
lesson.goal: Learn that a pendulum's period and swing speed do not depend on its mass, even though heavier bobs experience a stronger gravitational pull.
